mission: S2d1 - OpenAI chat client -> Gemini upstream
version_anchor: CLIProxyAPI v7.3.4 commit 8335eac731946bd4eff18f500653f93736df53d6; docker image eceasy/cli-proxy-api:v7.3.4 (digest sha256:97825da3009f98acf78b5c172fde650a5fbe7a690950a69ce6d7b535d77d4266)

mock.mode_control: mock/control/gemini.json (per-mission file). IMPORTANT: X-Mock-* headers do NOT reach the mock through the gateway because client headers are not forwarded upstream; use the control file for modes (happy/error/disconnect) and per-model scripted responses for content.
required_extensions: Key scripted responses by the URL model name (segment before ':generateContent'/':streamGenerateContent'). New scripted responses needed: gemini-mock-model-tools (functionCall non-stream reply + 3-event stream), gemini-mock-model-maxtok (MAX_TOKENS non-stream reply + 2-event stream), gemini-mock-model-usage (thought-parts reply), gemini-mock-model-n2 (2-candidate reply), gemini-mock-model-split (3-event split stream), gemini-mock-model-disc (3-event stream). Existing default reply (gemini-mock-model) unchanged.
Terminal stream events should carry modelVersion = <URL model> for the new keyed models (the default gemini-mock-model keeps its existing hardcoded value).
Keep X-Mock-* control-header support for direct-to-mock probes (it already exists).
